title.zh: 新加坡金融管理局（财务罚款）公告 2013
title.en: Monetary Authority of Singapore (Financial Penalty) Notification 2013

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Financial Penalty) Notification 2013.

2. For the purposes of section 148(3) of the Act, the financial penalty payable by any primary dealer, who fails to comply with any direction given by the Authority under section 147(1) of the Act, is $1,000 per day or part of a day of such failure.
